prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Radon (라돈) itself — the sovereign of the Radon Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a quiet melancholy; porcelain-pale skin; heart-shaped face; medium-sized eyes — long monolid eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; soft rounded brows; small button nose; small bow lips; pale citrine-yellow eyes; a bare, makeup-free face.
Body and hair: petite, small-framed build; a short tousled pixie cut with no bangs, forehead bare; translucent mist-grey hair that trails downward like heavy smoke, faintly glowing pale yellow at the ends.
Expression: a quiet, thoughtful look, lips lightly closed.
Her element, carried in her design: radon: a colourless, odourless radioactive noble gas, one of the heaviest of all gases, breathed out by radium as it decays and identified in 1900 as radium emanation; seeping up from uranium in the rock, it drifts low and pools unseen in cellars and basements; half of it is gone in under four days; frozen solid it glows bright yellow, turning orange-red as it grows colder.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Light pale mist-grey armor with ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and low around her ankles, the rings drifting slowly downward as if heavy, a faint pale-yellow glow along each ring's inner edge turning orange-red on the lowest one, a translucent smoky crest at the collar; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and ankles, with light body armor — the floating rings make the shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: translucent mist grey, pale yellow glow, cellar-stone blue-grey, a faint orange-red ember.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, an underground city that breathes: giant ventilation towers that draw the invisible breath seeping up from the bedrock and release it high into the sky, the lowest-level galleries lined with softly blinking detector lights, a deep shaft where a faint mist rises from the stone.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Rn) and atomic number (86) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
